steps: The maximum energy of the X-ray photon is E_X = eV = 24800 eV.
The wavelength of this X-ray is given by λ = hc / E_X.
The de-Broglie wavelength of an electron with kinetic energy K is λ_e = h / √(2mK).
Equating the two wavelengths (λ = λ_e), we get hc / E_X = h / √(2mK), which simplifies to K = E_X^2 / (2mc^2).
The rest mass energy of an electron is mc^2 ≈ 511 keV = 511,000 eV.
Substituting the values, K = (24800)^2 / (2 × 511000) ≈ 601 eV, which is approximately 600 eV.
